sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and face an Alsager side struggling near the bottom with just 4 points from 10 games. This should represent a good opportunity for the league leaders to bounce back and extend their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with both teams looking to climb further up the standings. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently fourth, welcome Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday, with both sides showing recent winning form. The title race remains competitive, as third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall (fifth), a direct clash between two strong teams. In-form Bilston Town (sixth, unbeaten in their last three) face Foley Meir at home. New Mills entertain Market Drayton Town in a mid-table encounter. Brereton Social, struggling with recent losses, host Widnes Town, who remain pointless this season. Crewe face Allscott Heath in a fixture between teams in the lower half. Shawbury United, on a run of six consecutive defeats, travel to face Barnton. Cheadle Heath Nomads, winless in their last five, visit Telford Town, another struggling side near the bottom.
